{{Update|[[Tales of the Jedi – The Freedon Nadd Uprising 1|''Tales of the Jedi – The Freedon Nadd Uprising'' 1]], [[Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War 2|''Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War'' 2]], [[Tales of the Jedi (audio drama)|''Tales of the Jedi'' audio drama]], [[Tales of the Jedi: Dark Lords of the Sith (audio drama)|''Tales of the Jedi: Dark Lords of the Sith'' audio drama]]}}
{{Quote|It seems that a very old prophecy is about to be fulfilled. The Dark Lords of the Sith may rise again.|Odan-Urr|<ref name="DLotSA">[[Tales of the Jedi: Dark Lords of the Sith (audio drama)|''Tales of the Jedi: Dark Lords of the Sith'' audio drama]]</ref>}}
[[File:UlicExarUnited.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Exar Kun and Ulic Qel-Droma, the foretold Lords of the Sith]]
A '''prophecy''' made around the time of the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]] foretold the return of the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lords of the Sith]].<ref name="DLotSA" /> The [[Sith sorcerer|Sith magician]] [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]] was aware of the prophecy and created a mighty [[Sithspawn/Legends|Sithspawn]] beast known as a [[Sith wyrm]] as a guardian against the future Dark Lord of the Sith.<ref name="DLotS4">[[Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith 4|''Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith'' 4]]</ref>

==History==
===Origin===
{{Quote|I just wish I knew what he meant about the Jedi.''"<br />"''Nadd spoke of the ancient prophecy that the Dark Lords of the Sith would come again. These prophecies chill my blood.''"<br />"''Are they true?''"<br />"''There may be something to them&hellip;but the future is always in motion. Ulic Qel-Droma, Nomi Sunrider, we are Jedi! The future depends on us!|Ulic Qel-Droma and Arca Jeth|<ref name="TOTJA">[[Tales of the Jedi (audio drama)|''Tales of the Jedi'' audio drama]]</ref>}}
A prophecy made around the time of the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]] foretold the return of the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lords of the Sith]].<ref name="DLotSA" /> After the former Dark [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]] fled to the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] following his defeat at the [[second battle of Korriban]] in [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]],<ref name="FotSE5">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire 5|''Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire'' 5]]</ref> Sadow became aware of the prophecy. He feared the return of the Dark Lords of the Sith and created a mighty [[Sithspawn/Legends|Sithspawn]] beast known as a [[Sith wyrm]] as a guardian against them.<ref name="DLotS4">[[Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith 4|''Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith'' 4]]</ref> The prophecy became part of legends of the [[Massassi/Legends|Massassi]] tribe that descended from the followers of Sadow on Yavin 4.<ref name="DLotS5">[[Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith 5|''Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith'' 5]]</ref>

===Ulic Qel-Droma===
{{Quote|I am here to warn you Jedi, you must not interfere with the work of the dark side. The Dark Lords of the Sith are destined to rise again. ''Nothing'' can prevent that.''"<br />"''You can't frighten us with useless prophecies. I thought Master Arca drove you away when he buried your bones on that barren moon.''"<br />"''Arca ''cannot'' interfere with the ''dead''&hellip;nor can he help ''you'', poor Jedi, to avoid your destiny.''"<br />"''What are you ''talking'' about?''"<br />"''You&hellip;will be one of the ''great ones''.|Freedon Nadd and Ulic Qel-Droma|audio=Nadd3-DLotS.flac|<ref name="DLotSA" />}}
[[File:NaddWarnsUlic-TOTJDLOTS1.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Ulic Qel-Droma is confronted by the spirit of Freedon Nadd.]]
During the [[Second Battle of Onderon]] of the [[Freedon Nadd Uprising]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Arca Jeth]] and a team of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] defeated [[King/Legends|King]] [[Ommin/Legends|Ommin]] of [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]]. The [[Force ghost/Legends|spirit]] of long-[[Death/Legends|dead]] Dark Lord of the Sith [[Freedon Nadd]] appeared at Ommin's side and ended his life, reminding him that these Jedi did not belong to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]]. Nadd soon corrected himself, however, and appeared to the Jedi Knight [[Ulic Qel-Droma/Legends|Ulic Qel-Droma]] claiming that perhaps one or two of the Jedi might belong to dark side. Freed by Ommin's death, Jeth emerged and claimed victory for the Jedi, however, Nadd, as he disappeared from sight, replied that the Jedi had actually lost, a statement which confused Qel-Droma. With the Freedon Nadd Uprising ended, Qel-Droma and other Jedi attended the long-awaited entombment of the recovered bodies of Amanoa and Nadd on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Dxun/Legends|Dxun]]. There, Qel-Droma asked Jeth about the meaning of Nadd's statement,<ref name="TFNU2">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Freedon Nadd Uprising 2|''Tales of the Jedi – The Freedon Nadd Uprising'' 2]]</ref> to which he replied that Nadd spoke of the ancient prophecy that foretold the return of the Dark Lords of the Sith. Qel-Droma wondered if these prophecies were true, to which Jeth replied that the future was always in motion; he declared to [[Nomi Sunrider]] and Ulic Qel-Droma that the future depended on the Jedi.<ref name="TOTJA" /> Following the Freedon Nadd Uprising, Nadd appeared to Qel-Droma and warned him not to interfere with the work of the dark side and proclaimed that the Sith would rise again. When Qel-Droma challenged Nadd on his assertions, Nadd told the Jedi that he would be one of the "great ones."<ref name="DLotS1">[[Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith 1|''Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith'' 1]]</ref> During the [[Conclave at Deneba]], Jedi Master [[Odan-Urr/Legends|Odan-Urr]] recited the prophecy to his fellow Jedi.<ref name="DLotSA" />

===Exar Kun===
{{Quote|Naga Sadow knew the ''prophecies''&hellip; He ''hated'' the Dark Lords! He feared ''your'' coming! He spawned ''monsters'' with his alchemy to ''destroy'' you!|Freedon Nadd to Exar Kun|<ref name="DLotS4" />}}
[[File:Kun_vs_Wyrm.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Naga Sadow's Sith wyrm guardian confronted Exar Kun on Yavin 4.]]
In [[3997 BBY]], the Jedi Knight [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]] explored the [[Tomb of Freedon Nadd]]. He was confronted by the spirit of Nadd, who told Kun that a great future awaited him in the dark side, but Kun dismissed the ghost's prophecy.<ref name="DLotS2">[[Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith 2|''Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith'' 2]]</ref> In the same year, Kun visited the moon of Yavin 4 and was defeated by the Massassi guards. Believing that Kun was someone whom they had been waiting for, the Massassi [[Sith temple/Legends|temple]] [[Priest/Legends|priest]] [[Zythmnr]] ordered that the former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] be brought to the [[Temple of Fire]], and summoned an ancient Sith wyrm to test his power. As he struggled in the beast's grasp, Kun heard Nadd's call who urged him to use the dark side and revealed to him that Sadow feared the prophecy of the Dark Lords and created the wyrm to destroy Kun. Suddenly finding that he could speak the Sith tongue, Kun [[Telekinesis/Legends|took]] Zythmnr's [[Sith talisman/Legends|Sith amulet]] and defeated the monster, winning the allegiance of Zythmnr and the other Massassi.<ref name="DLotS4" /> The [[Sith artifact/Legends|amulet]] caused Kun to experience a [[Force vision/Legends|Force vision]] of his destiny as the great and powerful Dark Lord of the Sith spoken of in the Massassi legends. Empowered by the vision,<ref name="DLotS5" /> Kun turned on the spirit of Nadd and, with a single burst of anger, obliterated the Sith spirit.<ref name="DLotS4" />

===Prophecy fulfilled===
{{Quote|The Dark Lords of the Sith have risen again. Together, we will bring down the galaxy!|Exar Kun to Ulic Qel-Droma|audio=TogetherWeWillBringDownTheGalaxy.flac|<ref name="DLotSA" />}}
[[File:Exarulicsithlords_b.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The spirit of Marka Ragnos proclaimed Exar Kun and Ulic Qel-Droma as Lords of the Sith.]]
On [[Empress Teta/Legends|Empress Teta]], Kun encountered Ulic Qel-Droma, a Jedi Knight who had lost his [[Arca Jeth|Master]] to a Krath attack and had gone undercover within the group to seek revenge. Qel-Droma had been seduced by the dark side himself, and while the two briefly [[Duel in the Iron Citadel (Exar Kun)|dueled]], their battle was ended as the Sith [[Force artifact/Legends|amulets]] they wore began interacting with each other. The energies formed an image of the ancient [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] and [[Unidentified Sith group|their Dark Lords]], a message carried in the two talismans for centuries. Finally, the spirit of long-dead Dark Lord [[Marka Ragnos]] appeared and named Kun the new Dark Lord of the Sith, his initiation into the dark side complete&mdash;with a single touch, Ragnos burned<ref name="DLotS6">[[Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith 6|''Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith'' 6]]</ref> a [[Mark of Dark Lord of the Sith|mark of a Dark Lord]]<ref name="KOTORCG">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''</ref> into the center of Kun's forehead,<ref name="DLotS6" /> and Qel-Droma with [[Mark of Shadow Hand|that]] of a [[Shadow Hand]],<ref name="KOTORCG" /> whom Ragnos said would become Kun's first and foremost apprentice. Bound by destiny and united by prophecy, they eagerly clasped hands,<ref name="DLotS6" /> while Kun proclaimed that the Sith have risen again and, together, they would bring down [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="DLotSA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The prophecy was first mentioned, albeit indirectly, in the [[Tales of the Jedi – The Freedon Nadd Uprising 1|first issue]] of the comic series ''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – The Freedon Nadd Uprising]]'', written by [[Tom Veitch]], illustrated by [[Tony Akins]], and published by [[Dark Horse Comics]]<ref name="TFNU1">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Freedon Nadd Uprising 1|''Tales of the Jedi – The Freedon Nadd Uprising'' 1]]</ref> on [[August 2]], [[1994]].<ref name="Publication">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54587/star_wars_tales_of_the_jedi_-_the_freedon_nadd_uprising_1994_1|text=Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi - The Freedon Nadd Uprising #1 (1994)}}</ref> It was first identified in the [[Tales of the Jedi (audio drama)|''Tales of the Jedi'' audio drama]], written by [[John Whitman]] and based on the script by Veitch.<ref name="TOTJA">[[Tales of the Jedi (audio drama)|''Tales of the Jedi'' audio drama]]</ref>

While [[Tales of the Jedi – The Freedon Nadd Uprising 2|''Tales of the Jedi – The Freedon Nadd Uprising'' 2]], ''Tales of the Jedi'' audio drama and [[Tales of the Jedi: Dark Lords of the Sith (audio drama)|''Tales of the Jedi: Dark Lords of the Sith'' audio drama]] establish that the prophecy foretold the return of the Dark Lords of the Sith, the [[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith|''Dark Lords of the Sith'']] <small>[sic]</small> comic story arc makes it clear that Exar Kun is the only Dark Lord of the Sith.
